title: Partite matching as a complete matching
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$. Relabel its vertices by the canonical bijection with a set of size $2rk$; the resulting matching is a perfect matching in the complete graph on those $2rk$ vertices.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$
